description: Land Acquisition - Block Nos. 03 & 02 of Cad. Map No. Maha 510282 of Wadurawa and Mottunna, Mirigama D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act for a public purpose (Central Express Way project). It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents. This falls squarely under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals.
